# Log10 <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Log10:Float32 float:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `float` | In | Float32 | required | A number above 0. |

**Returns:** The logarithm to base 10.

## Description

Returns the logarithm to base 10, which is how many times 10 goes into the number.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Log10(1000)
```

```text
3.0
```
